chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated from Muhammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
Abu ʿAbdillah (عليه السلام) called Abu al-Hasan (عليه السلام) one day while we were with him, and he said to us: “Hold fast to this one, for by Allah, he is your master after me.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, Imam Musa al-Kazim (عليه السلام)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu ʿAbdillah, Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)
key_terms.عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا: An instruction to adhere to and follow this person

ai.seo_question: How does al-Kafi narrate the designation of Imam Musa al-Kazim (عليه السلام) after Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a clear designation by Abu ʿAbdillah (عليه السلام) of Abu al-Hasan (عليه السلام) before those present. It is significant in Shia tradition as evidence for the succession and religious authority of Imam Musa al-Kazim (عليه السلام) after Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq (عليه السلام).
